title: What will Apple’s John Ternus era look like?
summary: It’s officially the Ternus era at Apple.   Tim Cook stepped down as CEO this week, handing the company to former hardware chief John Ternus, whose first memo promised a “huge launch next week” — timing that puts Apple’s next iPhone event on his desk before he’s even settled in. Cook isn’t going far, though: he’s staying on as Executive Chairman, focused on the kind of policy […]
llm_summary: Apple’s leadership has officially shifted to longtime hardware chief John Ternus, who succeeded Tim Cook as CEO while Cook remains executive chairman. In his first memo, Ternus promised a “huge launch” next week—meaning the upcoming iPhone event will be his first major test even before he’s fully settled into the role. The transition suggests continuity in Apple’s strategic direction, with Cook focusing on broader policy issues and Ternus steering day‑to‑day
